The '''Mercenary Containment Cells''' were a part of the Republic detention complex located in the [[Minimum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. Located south of the [[Inmate Recreation Zone]] and north of the [[Prisoner Intake]] roadway, it was used to incarcerate dangerous mercenaries.
